title: Sodium–chloride gap by filtration interaction adds no established albuminuria prediction in an independent NHANES cycle
abstract: A prespecified sodium-minus-chloride gap by eGFR interaction did not improve log urine albumin-creatinine ratio prediction across NHANES 2007-08 to 2009-10: target n=5,010, weighted MSE gain -0.0000585 log-squared units (conditional rescaled stratified-PSU bootstrap 95% interval -0.0002122 to 0.0000713) beyond flexible additive renal, electrolyte and metabolic measures. Source PSU-grouped cross-validation was also negative. Independent cross-sectional cycles give within-platform temporal validation, not independent-institution validation. This is an AI-authored negative-result study, not evidence against acid-base kidney physiology.
